name: Pyon Mart
pitch: Walk around a 3D Japanese convenience store, pick up anything, and read the Japanese on all of it.
problem: Textbook Japanese never looks like a real shop shelf.

stats.label: words to find, each with its reading
image or model files: all drawn in code

features.title: Hover to read
features.text: Point at any Japanese text in the shop to see its reading and meaning.
details: Packaging, signs, price tags, posters, even the road
A word book keeps track of the ones you've found
Hiragana-only mode reprints every label in kana

screen.alt: Inside the shop, hovering over the レジ sign shows its reading れじ, romaji reji and meaning register / checkout

features.title: Day and night
features.text: A time-of-day slider moves the sun and moon across the sky.
details: At night the sign, windows and vending machines glow

screen.alt: Pyon Mart at night under a starry sky, its sign, windows and vending machines lit up

features.title: Pick it up
features.text: Click any product to turn it over in your hands.
details: Store-brand lines share one look, like a real konbini

features.title: Check out
features.text: Bring your basket to the register for the usual questions.
details: 温めますか？ 袋はご利用ですか？

screens.alt: Pyon Mart from the car park: the shopfront with banners for oden, ice cream and autumn flavours, and vending machines
screens.caption: Open 24 hours
